newsitem.title: USA: Ingersoll-Rand sets 10 mln shr buyback plan.
newsitem.headline: Ingersoll-Rand sets 10 mln shr buyback plan.

text.p: Ingersoll-Rand Co on Wednesday said its board of directors authorized the repurchase of up to 10 million shares of its common stock.
The company, which makes air compressors and other non-electrical machinery, said it had 109.8 million shares of common stock outstanding at April 30..
The company said the repurchases would replenish its treasury shares after a transfer of stock to a leveraged employee stock-ownership plan related to the acquisition of Clark Equipment Co.
The company said it would accumulate additional treasury shares, which will be available for general corporate purposes.
